patches.rationale: The bug: `dict(reservations)` collapses repeated SKU entries, keeping only the last quantity, so `[('A',2),('A',3)]` reserves 3 instead of 5. Fix by summing all reservation quantities per SKU. Clamp at zero via max(0, ...). Unknown SKUs are naturally ignored since we only iterate stock items. Inputs are preserved (no mutation of stock or reservations). Add a new regression test file covering repeated SKUs, clamping, unknown SKUs, input preservation, and exact types.
